learning_outcomes.text: Students can functionally and problem-oriented analyze development tasks in the conception phase.
Students are familiar with the systematic design process: specification phase, concept phase, solution selection and evaluation, design phase and elaboration phase.
Students are able to understand and evaluate technical and economic relationships.
Students know the influence of the lifecycle, quantity, and degree of novelty of a product.
Students know the difference between basic design rules, design principles, and design guidelines.
Students are able to apply the basic steps of goal definition, problem analysis, solution finding, and solution evaluation.
Methodically lower the level of abstraction to find concrete solutions and innovation.
Transfer knowledge/skills to specific mechanical engineering / engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental process from abstract idea to concrete innovation
Establishing functional analyses and functional structures
Applying evaluation methods and selection criteria
Developing problem-focused, innovative solution concepts, including non-conventional, inventive solution approaches
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the written examination. Active participation in the practical training, including submission of elaborations, is a prerequisite for taking the exam. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
bibliography: Schaeffler, Technisches Taschenbuch, Schaeffler Technologies AG & Co.KG
